column2: The following pages contain the Remote Control codes (sometimes called “hex codes”)
They are in “Pronto format”, which is accepted by the old Pronto series remote controls, and a huge
assortment of other devices which are compatible with that standard.
These are current and confirmed to work as of January 11, 2013 - and are not expected to change.
Please note that we are not able to support specific remote control devices or editors.
